answer: Sell a fixed number of participation slots each epoch by sealed-bid auction: every agent bids locked tokens for one terrace seat, winners lock their bid, losers get refunded. A sybil attacker must win a separate auction for each fake identity, so a hundred sock puppets cost a hundred winning bids, and scarcity pushes the price up as more fakes enter. Old seats never carry over, so no relic of past access survives, and bids are hidden behind a cipher commitment, so nobody can snipe the price. Honest agents pay once; attackers pay per identity.
